At later levels can also call in air-strikes on the path. |tooltip-2 = Units are capable of detecting [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] enemies. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Send out a vehicle every couple of seconds to run over and shoot enemies.|Store Description}} {{QuoteBox|Send out a vehicle every couple of seconds to run over and shoot zombies.|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Military Base''' is an intermediate [[Towers|tower]] that spawns various military-themed vehicles, which can be bought in the store for {{Coins|4,000}}. Levels 0-3 will spawn [[Humvee]]s of varying strength, Level 4 will spawn a [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] and Level 5 will spawn a [[Railgun Tank]]. Periodically, the '''Military Base''' will spawn a [[Units|unit]] at the end of the path. The unit will head towards the start of the path until it gets destroyed, damaging enemies along the way. If it reaches the entrance, the unit will disappear. When there are enemies in a unit's range, it will slow down so that it has more time to attack enemies. For the first two upgrades, the main purpose of this tower is to spawn units with its ''Military Caravan'' that deal direct collision damage to enemies ([[Humvee]] and [[Humvee 2]]). After Level 3, the unit itself ([[Humvee 3]]) can deal damage through ranged weapons, and after Level 4, units spawned by the '''Military Base''' can deal ranged [[Splash Damage|splash damage]] ([[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] and [[Railgun Tank]]). The explosion is separated into two spheres. Enemies in the inner sphere will be dealt 100% of the stated damage, while the damage in the outer sphere is decreased linearly. Its splash damage deals full damage to enemies with [[defense]]. '''Military Base''' spawns can damage [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] enemies through collision or splash, but not with their mounted guns. Both the tower and units are immune to debuffs, units being fully and while technically the tower can receive some debuffs, none of them can actually impact any of its stats. These units cannot be stunned, but they can be damaged by certain enemy abilities. At Level 4, the '''Military Base''' gains the ''Airstrike'' ability which drops six bombs in a cluster around on a specified path location when used. The bombs cause explosions that damage any enemies within the blast radius. Like all explosions, the explosion is separated into two spheres. Enemies in the inner sphere will be dealt 100% of the stated damage, while the damage in the outer sphere is decreased linearly. Its splash damage also deals full damage to enemies regardless of if they have [[defense]] or not. At Level 5, the bombs gain more damage and have a larger blast radius. The '''Military Base''' is considered an all-round tower. Its cheap placement cost and early upgrade are affordable in the early game, and its base units, such as the [[Humvee]] and [[Humvee 2]] can deal with lower health enemies. Later on, its later expensive upgrades, but more advanced units like the [[Tank]] and [[Railgun Tank]] can deal with higher health enemies that appear onwards in the mid to late game. [[Patriotic Crate]] |- ! |[[File:IceCreamMilitaryBaseIconIG.png|175px]] |[[File:PirateMilitaryBase0.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Beach|Ice Cream}} |{{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Common}} |{{Color|Rare}} |- !Daily Store Cost |N/A |{{Coins|4,500}} |- !Obtained From |[[Beach Crate]] |[[Pirate Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *Upgrading a '''Military Base''' to Level 1 reduces the spawnrate by 10 seconds, allowing the unit to spawn in 35 seconds instead of 45. **Selling a '''Military Base''' will destroy the unit. **In [[PVP]], the spawnrate is even shorter for both Level 0 and Levels 1-5 by 5 seconds, making it spawn far faster there. *A few [[Humvee 2]]s can easily take out hordes of early game enemies. *The '''Military Base''' can be an effective counter for enemies with defense, like the [[Fallen Jester]] and [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]], as they deal full damage when colliding with these enemies. **The damage from its cannon and ''Airstrike'' also deals full damage to defense enemies. However, the gun damage is still affected. *The ''Airstrike'' ability unlocked at Level 4 can be very effective at clearing out hordes of enemies. **As it deals splash damage, it ignores defense, making it especially useful against enemies like the [[Fallen Hero]]. **It should not be used against single high health enemies, like the [[Fallen Tank]], due to its long cooldown. *Because of its large placement footprint and the fact it spawns units regardless of where it is placed, it should be placed away from the path as it can take up important space from other towers. *It is recommended to use the [[Farm]], [[Cowboy]] or [[Golden Cowboy]] with '''Military Base''' due to it being expensive to upgrade to Level 5. **You can also use the [[DJ Booth]] to lower the upgrade costs of the '''Military Base'''. Make sure it is within the range of the tower itself. *Stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Freezer]] pairs well with the '''Military Base''' as they slow down enemies before colliding with [[units]], allowing the [[units]] to survive longer. *The '''Military Base''' is not recommended for short maps, such as [[Dead Ahead]], as their long spawnrate makes them more ineffective. **In two-pathed maps, only one unit spawns as opposed to two. This unit will go down a random path. ***This also applies to other multi-pathed maps such as the [[Derelict Outpost]] and the [[Infernal Abyss]]. *[[Units]] spawned by the '''Military Base''' are not fully affected by any buffs and debuffs. **''Airstrike'' and cannon's explosion are affected by [[Damage Buff]]s, meaning that the [[Mercenary Base]] can be used to buff its damage. ***The [[Field Medic]] spawned by it cannot heal or shield any of the '''Military Base's''' units. *[[Units]] spawned by the '''Military Base''' are useless against flying as they cannot collide nor detect them. **However, the '''Military Base''' can still be useful against such enemies because of its ''Airstrike'' ability. **They also cannot collide with ghost enemies, though the [[Humvee 3]], [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]], [[Railgun Tank]] can detect them as it has hidden detection. **However, they are effective against lead enemies, as collision deals damage to lead enemies. ***Additionally, the cannon splash damage can also deal damage to lead enemies. *If the units from the '''Military Base''' are very close to each other, they may be able to support each other with their gunfire, thereby reducing the amount of enemies to collide into, and allowing them to survive longer. **However, if this is your main source of DPS, the long gap between the spawn times may prove to be a detriment. *The '''Military Base's''' units are not very effective against large crowds of high health enemies, like the [[Breaker4]], as their high amounts of health mean that the units will be killed quite quickly if collided with. **Its ''Airstrike'' ability can be quite useful against them, but do note that it has a rather long cooldown. ==Trivia== *The '''Military Base''' is based on ''Tower Battles's'' [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Patrol|Patrol]]. *The '''Military Base''' was originally meant to deploy soldiers upon the vehicle's destruction, these would attack enemies but would not be damaged by them. They would only last for a few seconds before despawning. **At the final Level, these soldiers were planned to have a bazooka. *Before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the spawnrate of the '''Military Base''' could be decreased by a [[Commander]], it was through an unconventional method. The stated buff was subtracted from the spawnrate (an example is a 25% buff on a Level 5 '''Military Base'''; the spawnrate would decrease from 45 to 44.75). **As 44.75 seconds rounds up to 45 seconds, there was no noticeable decrease in spawn time. ***Interestingly, the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability reduced the spawnrate of [[units]] from the '''Military Base''' further, but even this buff could not produce a noticeable decrease in spawnrate. *[[Humvee]]s, [[Tank (Unit)|Tanks]], and [[Railgun Tank]]s will be destroyed if their respective '''Military Base''' is sold. *The '''Military Base''' was made unusable between the 21st of July 2021 and 22 July 2021, because if multiple units spawned very close to each other it would lag out the game, giving players an unfair advantage. This glitch no longer works. **You could still equip the '''Military Base''' in your loadout, despite it being unusable. However, placing it would make the following message appear: "''Military Base placement has been temporarily disabled. This unit is faulty, allowing players to gain an unfair advantage.''" *The Level 5 '''Military Base''' used to be the most expensive upgrade in the game for quite a long time. When the [[v1.2.0|Duck Hunt Update]] released, it added the [[Engineer]] tower, which had a more expensive upgrade cost. **Later with updates, more towers would get upgrades that were more expensive than the '''Military Base's''' Level 5 upgrade, such as the [[Turret]] or [[Accelerator]]. *The aircraft responsible for orchestrating the airstrike is a [[wp:Northrop Grumman B-2 Spirit|Northrop Grumman B-2 'Spirit']] stealth bomber. *The arrow on the ''Airstrike's'' marker is the tangent line of the plane's flight of where it drops the bombs. It is based on the line passing through the coordinates of the player's camera and the selected path. **If multiple ''Airstrikes'' are selected at once, the planes fly on equiangular flight paths relative to each other. *Oddly enough, the '''Military Base''' tower itself has range, despite the fact that it only spawns units. ==Update History== ''For previous cosmetic variations, see the
